answer.says: Shri Hegde, you will find the second bedroom ready. The air is thick with dust today, so I shall take a brief walk in Lodhi Gardens to clear my head. Do not wait up for me.
answer.thought: Shri Hegde has retreated to his room, leaving the house to its silence and the morning to its haze. My plan dictates a walk in Lodhi Gardens, where the tombs of the Lodis stand as monuments to a history that moved, unlike the static dreaming of the East. I need to see if the spirit of the city is as sluggish as the air, or if there is movement beneath the dust.
